Subject: Marketplace interop: priorities and exception asks

Hi Jonas / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we're excited about Redwood as a hosting option for our connector. We ran an initial compatibility scan and attached the CSV with current integration surface area. A few things we need clarity on before we lock dates: 

- Entitlements: can Redwood support marketplace-managed entitlements for reserved capacity + overage billing? We have a complicated seat-based model.
- Private images and AMI mapping: our SI partner typically needs a private image; does Redwood have an exemption path for private images on the marketplace listing?
- Deployment options: the customer will likely require a VPC/on-prem option for data residency — what is the timeline to support that for a non-enterprise pilot?
- Security evidence: we need SOC2 + pen test artifacts for our procurement.

High-level ask: can we get a prioritization decision and an exceptions path by the end of next week so we can update our internal roadmap? Also happy to hop on a 30-min call — Calendly link below.

Attachments: saasco-integration-scan.csv (summary rows)

Cheers,
Ethan Ross
Head of Integrations, SaaSCo Integrations
ethan.ross@saasco.com

Thanks Ethan — digging into the CSV now. A few quick clarifying Qs so we can route to the right teams: 

1) Entitlements model: can you share a short example of the seat-based billing flow (invoice vs marketplace metering)? If it's marketplace metering we need to check compatibility with our entitlement service.
2) Private image: is the private image required for initial pilot or only for GA? If possible, a pilot without a private AMI would make the path faster.
3) VPC/on-prem pilot: is the requirement a customer-specific VPC peering or a general private deployment package we ship to customers?

Tentative internal owners: Vanessa (Marketplace/Partnerships) will own listing exceptions, Irene (Platform) owns VPC/private deploy feasibility, Ben (Billing) will weigh in on entitlements.

Proposed next step: Vanessa and I will propose a prioritized list of three items (must-have, nice-to-have, downgrade) and circulate a MAP. Can you confirm you have SOC2 Type II reports and the contact for your SI partner (Meera?) so we can start a security intake?

Thanks —
Jonas

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace interop: priorities and exception asks

Ethan — quick internal note followed by proposals.

Internal constraints (high level):
- Q2 roadmap is gated: we have a Marketplace connector sprint in late Q2 but capacity for new expedited connectors is limited.
- Private-image exceptions require security review and additional entitlements work; historically this adds 6–10 weeks.
- VPC/on-prem pilot is on our Private cadence; we can onboard a pilot if the customer signs the Private pilot SLA and accepts a one-off onboarding fee.

Proposed options for SaaSCo (choose one):
A) Standard Marketplace path (fastest): publish a public listing using our hosted integration model. No private image. Timeline: 6–8 weeks for listing QA and docs.
B) Expedited connector + limited exception: Redwood builds the connector in an 8-week expedited stream if SaaSCo commits to an entitlement waiver (we will detail the waiver) and provides a dev environment with sample data. This still requires SOC2 artifacts up front.
C) Private pilot: out-of-band Private deployment on a customer-specific VPC; timeline 10+ weeks with onboarding fee and security review.

Security asks: please share SOC2 Type II report and your pen-test summary. Also we will send a short security questionnaire (Irene will own).

If you select B, we will need a signed exceptions acceptance to lock the expedited slot. I've attached a short doc outlining what we need from you (prod-roadmap-asks.pdf).

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear options. SaaSCo reviewed internally and we're leaning to option B (expedited connector + entitlement waiver). Confirmations: 

- We can provide SOC2 Type II and the last pen-test summary by tomorrow evening.
- Meera Patel (cc'd) is our SI partner lead and will provide a dev environment and sample data for the expedited stream.
- We'll sign the exceptions acceptance (please send the DocuSign link).

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Send the exceptions acceptance via DocuSign (Ethan + Meera to sign)
- Schedule a 30-min kickoff to align owners and artifacts: https://calendly.com/ethan-ross/30min

I attached an internal note with instructions for the dev environment (access-instructions.md).

Ethan
